dedupe_keys.name: renewable energy and electricity demand time series dataset with exogenous variables at 5 minute interval

description: Renewable Energy and Electricity Demand Time Series Dataset with Exogenous Variables at 5-minute Interval is a dataset listed in Open Energy Hub (ORNL), an energy-sector data hub, published or maintained by Oak Ridge National Laboratory for the U.S. DOE Office of Electricity. The described database was created using data obtained from the California Independent System Operator (CAISO) and the National Laboratory of the Rockies (NRL). All data was collected at five-minute intervals, and subsequently cleaned and modified to create a database comprising three time series: solar energy production, wind energy production, and electricity demand. Coverage: the United States. The portal files it under Electricity, Renewables. Its keywords are renewable energy, solar power, wind power, electricity generation. The portal shows 2024-07-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oeh-open-data-portal.
